text.de: Die Mehrheit der Kunden beschreibt das Praxisteam als überaus freundlich, empathisch und fachlich herausragend. Stammkunden betonen das vertrauensvolle Verhältnis über viele Jahre. text.en: The majority of clients describe the practice team as exceptionally friendly, empathetic, and highly competent. Long-term pet owners emphasize trusted relationships spanning several years. However, individual drop-in visitors without appointments felt dismissed and criticized reception helpfulness.

title.en: Specialized care for birds and reptiles

text.de: Besondere Anerkennung findet die Expertise bei exotischen Heimtieren wie Bartagamen und Nymphensittichen. text.en: Reviewers particularly recognize the practice's specialized expertise with exotic pets, including bearded dragons and cockatiels. text.de: Kunden berichten über gelungene chirurgische Eingriffe bei Katzen sowie Vögeln und loben die komplikationslose Heilung. text.en: Clients report successful surgical interventions for both cats and birds, praising uncomplicated recovery processes. Post-operative aftercare is also commended, as follow-up questions were addressed readily. Veterinary therapeutic guidance delivers reliable and lasting recovery outcomes.
